text: just tell me why it happened and guarantee me it can never happen again and we can move on
resolution: Made the exact collapse class structurally impossible. Paint-only persistence no longer writes doc.blob or base.blob. Every editable save now requires an exact one-to-one host-range/Outliner-row count, including single-part models; a shrink is refused unless an actual Delete, Merge, or shrinking Undo minted a one-shot capability for that exact resulting count. The native RJMD writer independently validates sorted non-overlapping ranges plus the expected count, writes a complete fsynced temp file, and atomically renames it over doc.blob; metadata is then atomically written. Resident geometry never crosses the JS bridge. Regression coverage proves the old paint-only path performs zero editable-mesh writes and Zig range validation rejects missing, extra, overlapping, and empty tables. TS tests are 9/9, Zig mesh tests 29/29, codegen is clean, and the ReleaseFast editor build passes.
